en: A Swedish illustrated New Year postcard. The front shows a Jenny Nyström scene of a red‑capped tomte in a stable petting a horse, with a cat nearby; printed greeting reads "Godt nytt år." Publisher credit at the margin: "Axel Eliassons Konstförlag, Stockholm." The reverse has a green ornamental border with Swedish headings "BREFKORT (CARTE POSTALE)" and the note that this side is for the address only, with handwritten address to Malmö; the stamp area is torn.
